title: Blini with Yeast Russian Buckwheat Delight
description: A classic Russian buckwheat pancake recipe, served with a side of yeast-based yeast sauce. Perfect for a breakfast or brunch dish.

ingredients.name: Blini (Buckwheat Pancakes)
ingredients.notes: Available at most Russian markets or online.

ingredients.name: Yeast Sauce
ingredients.notes: Can be made with store-bought yeast or homemade.

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast, sugar, and warm water.
Let it sit for 5-10 minutes, until yeast is activated and foamy.
Add flour, buckwheat flour, eggs, milk, and salt to the bowl.
Mix well until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the blini and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the blini hot with a dollop of yeast sauce and a pat of butter.
